description: Return stored forecasts, consensus-style predictions, central-bank projections, survey forecasts, IMF forecasts, nowcasts, or FXMacroData blended predictions for macro announcements, for actual-vs-consensus, prior-vs-forecast, or event-surprise context. Rows are keyed by announcement_id/date/indicator and include prediction source metadata. Supported currencies: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur. The `indicator` parameter lists the accepted indicator slugs. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

annualization.description: Annualization selector, matching the announcement series.

as_of.description: Historical publication cutoff with explicit timezone, or YYYY-MM-DD at UTC midnight. Later forecasts are excluded.

basis.description: Real or nominal selector, matching the announcement series.

before_date.description: Exclusive period-date cursor for event-linked groups; use the prior response's next_cursor.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (case-insensitive). Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive upper bound by reference-period date, YYYY-MM-DD.

event_compatible_only.description: Restrict event-linked data to verified matching target periods, units and economic concepts. Native official_forecasts remain a separate section.

frequency.description: Returned change basis selector, matching the announcement series.

indicator.description: Required indicator slug. Currency-wide prediction reads are not supported. Supported: catalogue indicator slug, e.g. inflation or policy_rate.

limit.description: Maximum prediction groups to return. Defaults to 20; maximum 100.

official_limit.description: Maximum native-period official forecasts; 0 omits this section. Inspect official_forecasts_truncated.

page.description: One-based page number. When supplied, overrides offset.

period_aggregation.description: Period aggregation selector, matching the announcement series.

pre_release_only.description: Require event-linked forecasts to have been generated before the announcement.

prediction_class.description: Forecast production class: compiled_consensus, forecaster_survey, expectations_survey, market_implied, model_nowcast, central_bank_projection, institutional_projection or fxmacrodata.

prediction_source.description: Optional source slug filter, for example ecb_spf or philly_fed_spf.

prediction_type.description: Optional legacy forecast-type filter, kept for existing clients. Superseded by prediction_class: compiled_consensus, forecaster_survey, expectations_survey, market_implied, model_nowcast, central_bank_projection, institutional_projection or fxmacrodata.

seasonality.description: Seasonal adjustment selector, matching the announcement series.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive lower bound by reference-period date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: event_predictions
title: Event Predictions
